messages:
ana: Quick sync request 1. We're shaping a 'Tiered Burst & Surge' packaging idea: tiered reserved capacity + on-demand surge credits + per-route soft caps. Need launch checklist and contract guardrails. 2pm?

sam: 2pm works. Product ask: define what surge credits look like (tokens or requests) and expiry rules. Also need clear customer language for 'soft caps'.

liz: Quality note: any surge route that causes model fallback must pass the eval set with <4% regression. Otherwise sales will get support tickets.

mohit: Implementation: we can represent surge credits as token buckets per-tenant with windowed refill. Soft caps enforced by throttling and priority weights. Infra impact small for soft caps; dedicated lanes for hard caps.

ralph: Commercial: prefer selling burst as bundles (e.g., 1M tokens/month) with rollover only for committed tiers. Pilot discount = 20% with 2mo min.

legal: Don't use 'rollover' without clear limits. Pilot addendum must include misuse clause and termination for sustained overuse. I'll draft minimal language.

ops-bot: Attached: top-route burst patterns CSV: https://internal.redwood/exports/burst-patterns.csv (uploaded)

sam: Proposed launch criteria: docs + billing table finalized, pilot contract approved, observability (per-tenant token usage + surge depletion alerts) live, and quality guardrail met.

liz: Add customer-facing wording: "Surge credits: consumable token bundles that expire monthly; soft caps apply and graceful fallback is documented."

mohit: Router example for RFC: ```yaml
surge_policy:
  type: token_bucket
  refill_interval: 86400
  bucket_size_tokens: 1000000
priority_weights:
  tiered: 1.4
  standard: 1.0
```

ana: Action items: book 2pm sync (ana), sam pricing table by EOD, mohit infra note 24h, legal pilot clause 48h, liz eval set tomorrow, ops-bot attach perf traces. I'll post RFC after sync.

ralph: Agree pilot should be paid to capture usage signals. 20% off + 2mo min sounds good.

ana: Thanks all 1 will update thread with RFC link and follow-up date.
